@manielng Your last comment just looks like your `neovim` python module (`pip install --upgrade neovim`) is old. Please try `:CheckHealth`, and if that doesn't give any clues, report in a separate issue.

@manielng Regarding the original issue: that plugin requires `instant-markdown-d`. What does 

```
:!instant-markdown-d
```

show?

To reproduce, download [issue5241.txt](https://github.com/neovim/neovim/files/438565/issue5241.txt)  (from https://github.com/suan/vim-instant-markdown/issues/98), then:

```
call system('curl -X PUT -T - http://localhost:8090/ &>/dev/null &', join(readfile('issue5241.txt', 0)))
```

Observations:
- Dependent on the size of the file (maybe a buffer-flush race).
  - The attached file is enough to abort on OSX 10.10.5
  - On ubuntu, try increasing the file by 4x.
- Not caused by #4646.
@justinmk I updated the python module , there are no error now, thanks!
